PasskeySection.needsSecureConnection: Passkeys need a secure connection. This page is loaded over plain HTTP. Enable HTTPS or use reverse proxy.

ApiTokensSection.title: API tokens
ApiTokensSection.desc: Tokens let the CLI or other scripts use the API without a password.
ApiTokensSection.namePlaceholder: Name this token (for example: laptop cli)
ApiTokensSection.createTokenDesc: This token will have full API access until you revoke it.
ApiTokensSection.createTokenDescReadOnly: This token can only read data.
ApiTokensSection.revealDesc: You can see this token only once. Copy it now and store it somewhere safe.

ServicesSection.warningContainers: Stopping or restarting this will interrupt any running containers.
ServicesSection.warningSmb: Stopping or restarting this will drop active SMB client connections.
ServicesSection.warningNfs: Stopping or restarting this will drop active NFS client connections.
ServicesSection.warningSsh: Stopping or restarting this may drop your current SSH session and any other active SSH connections.
ServicesSection.warningAvahi: Stopping or restarting this may drop network discovery
ServicesSection.warningTailscale: Stopping or restarting this will drop the Tailscale connection.
ServicesSection.warningRclone: Stopping or restarting this will interrupt any Remote Backup sync currently in progress.
ServicesSection.stillNotBack: Still not back after 30s - check the backend on the host, or reload this page.
ServicesSection.startOnBootDesc: Disabling only stops sshd from starting next boot - it won't drop this or any other currently-open SSH session. Use Stop above for that.
ServicesSection.reloadDriverDesc: Restarts NonRAID Kernel Driver. Only restart if you know what you are doing!

TwoFactorSection.saveBackupCodesDesc: Each code works once. Save them somewhere safe before continuing, they will not be shown again.
TwoFactorSection.scanTitle: Scan this code with your authenticator app
TwoFactorSection.scanDesc: Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or any other TOTP app. Can't scan? Enter this secret manually:
TwoFactorSection.notEnabled: Not enabled. Adds a code from an authenticator app as 2FA.

UpdateSection.confirmTextNonraid: Rebuilds the NonRAID kernel module via DKMS. New version is applied on reboot.
UpdateSection.confirmTextNonraidWebui: This takes a pre-update snapshot, pulls the new release, rebuilds nonraid-webui, and restarts the backend. Nonraid will be unavailable during the process.
UpdateSection.restarting: Restarting nonraid-webui - this page will reconnect automatically in a few seconds…
UpdateSection.restartTimedOut: Still not reachable after a couple of minutes. Refresh browser or check the service on the host (`systemctl status nonraid-webui`).
UpdateSection.olderBuild: Older build - reload from Settings > Services

TlsSection.selfSignedWarning: Self-signed certificate - your browser will show a security warning the first time you visit over HTTPS. This is expected; accept/proceed past it once per browser/device.
TlsSection.restartingRedirect1: Restarting with the new settings - you'll be redirected to
TlsSection.restartingRedirect2: in a few seconds. If this is a self-signed certificate, your browser will show a security warning; this is expected, proceed past it. If it doesn't come back, browse to {{origin}} directly.
TlsSection.mainFqdnHint: Main FQDN, IP, or hostname address. Ex. nonraid.lan
TlsSection.importCertificateDesc: A real CA-issued certificate, or one produced by an ACME client run elsewhere.
TlsSection.subject: Subject:
TlsSection.keysDontMatch: this certificate and key don't belong together, cannot import.

TailscaleSection.title: Tailscale
TailscaleSection.notInstalled2: package isn't installed on this host. Re-run
TailscaleSection.notInstalled3: (or install it manually) to enable this section.
TailscaleSection.desc: Reach this NAS securely from anywhere over your tailnet, without opening any ports. Signin to your Tailscale account or provide a custom login server such as Headscale.
TailscaleSection.loginServerHint: Leave blank to use Tailscale's own server, or set a self-hosted Headscale URL.
TailscaleSection.openLinkToSignIn: Open this link to finish signing in:
TailscaleSection.tailscaleSshDesc: Lets tailnet members SSH into this host through Tailscale, using its own access rules.
TailscaleSection.acceptDnsDesc: Use the DNS settings (including MagicDNS) configured for your tailnet.
TailscaleSection.advertiseLanDesc: CIDRs to advertise as subnet routes, comma-separated (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24) - lets other tailnet devices reach your home network through this NAS. Disabled by default; each route also needs approving in your Tailscale/Headscale admin console.
TailscaleSection.acceptRoutesDesc: Let this NAS reach subnets advertised by other devices on your tailnet. Disabled by default.
TailscaleSection.savedAdvertiseRoutes: Saved. Advertised routes may need approval in your Tailscale/Headscale admin console before they take effect.

ConfigRestoreWizard.pickArchiveDesc: Pick a config backup archive. Nothing on this host changes until you confirm on the last step.
ConfigRestoreWizard.passwordEncrypted: is password-encrypted. Enter its password to view.
ConfigRestoreWizard.stopArrayFirstDesc: Restoring config while the array is running can cause data loss. Stop the array and try again.
ConfigRestoreWizard.superblockRestoredDesc: Using archive's superblock to restore previous array as well as the rest of the config.
ConfigRestoreWizard.superblockSkippedDesc: This array already has disks assigned, so the archive's superblock is skipped for safety - restoring it here would bypass the disk-matching checks Settings → Import Existing Array has. Use that instead if you specifically need to restore the array itself.
ConfigRestoreWizard.noSuperblockRecorded: This backup doesn't have an array superblock. There's nothing to recover the array from.
ConfigRestoreWizard.showAllFiles_one: Show all {{count}} file in this archive
ConfigRestoreWizard.showAllFiles_other: Show all {{count}} files in this archive
ConfigRestoreWizard.overwriteWarning_one: This overwrites {{count}} file at its original location on this host, covering only what's checked on the previous step. There's no undo beyond restoring a different (or older) backup afterward.
ConfigRestoreWizard.overwriteWarning_other: This overwrites {{count}} files at their original locations on this host, covering only what's checked on the previous step. There's no undo beyond restoring a different (or older) backup afterward.
ConfigRestoreWizard.acknowledgeOverwrite: I understand this overwrites live config files and want to proceed.
ConfigRestoreWizard.superblockSkippedNote: array superblock skipped, array already has disks assigned
ConfigRestoreWizard.restartNeeded: Samba/NFS, the driver, {{docker}}and nonraid-webui itself all need to restart to fully restore.
ConfigRestoreWizard.dockerRestartWarning: Restarting Docker stops every currently-running container until it comes back up.
ConfigRestoreWizard.superblockReloadFailed: The restored array superblock is on disk, but reloading the driver to pick it up failed:
ConfigRestoreWizard.retryBelow: Restart services below to retry it.
ConfigRestoreWizard.usersRestoreFailed: Recreating users/groups from the backup failed:
ConfigRestoreWizard.restartingServicesDesc: Restarting SMB, NFS, the driver, and Remote Backup, then nonraid-webui itself - this page will reconnect automatically once it's back.
ConfigRestoreWizard.restartTimedOut: nonraid-webui didn't come back within 2 minutes. Refresh browser or check `systemctl status nonraid-webui` on the host.

ImportArrayWizard.title: Import array
ImportArrayWizard.migratingDesc1: If migrating from Unraid, or bringing back a previous nonraid array, follow
ImportArrayWizard.migratingDesc2: if you're coming from Unraid, move the disks over first, then pick the original file below - usually named
ImportArrayWizard.migratingDesc3: on an Unraid flash drive, or
ImportArrayWizard.migratingDesc4: from a previous install. Nothing on this host changes until you confirm on the last step.
ImportArrayWizard.foundOnBootDisk: Found on this system's own boot disk - the array's current superblock file.
ImportArrayWizard.browsingDesc1: Browsing this host's own root filesystem, read-only - useful if a
ImportArrayWizard.browsingDesc2: backup is already sitting somewhere on this same boot disk.
ImportArrayWizard.replaceActiveArrayTitle: This will replace the currently active array
ImportArrayWizard.replaceActiveArrayDesc: Continuing stops the array, unloads the driver, and reloads it with this superblock instead. The current array's existing superblock file is backed up first.
ImportArrayWizard.parityTooSmallTitle: Parity is smaller than the largest data disk
ImportArrayWizard.parityTooSmallDesc: The driver refuses to start an array like this (ERROR:PARITY_NOT_BIGGEST). You can still review and import, but starting the array afterward will fail until this is corrected.
ImportArrayWizard.sizeMismatchDesc: One or more disks below don't match the size recorded in the superblock. Importing can corrupt filesystems and lose data, cowardly failling. Reconnect the correct disk, or unassign the affected slot in Unraid and regenerate the superblock, then try again.
ImportArrayWizard.missingDataHint: After import, replace this disk from the Disks page to start a rebuild.
ImportArrayWizard.missingParityHint: After import, assign a parity disk from the Disks page - there's no prior data to rebuild from, so this needs a fresh parity build instead.
ImportArrayWizard.confirmStopsCurrentArray: This stops the currently running array, backs up its superblock, and loads this one instead.
ImportArrayWizard.confirmLoadsSuperblock: This loads this superblock and imports the disks that match it.
ImportArrayWizard.arrayNotStartedAutomatically: Review array status afterward and start it when ready.
ImportArrayWizard.acknowledgeConfigChange: I understand this changes the array's configuration and want to proceed.
ImportArrayWizard.importBlocked: Import is blocked - see the size mismatch above. Go back and resolve it before continuing.
ImportArrayWizard.checkRawOutput: Check the raw output below and the array status before starting.
ImportArrayWizard.importedDisksDesc_one: Imported {{count}} disk. Review the array status, then start the array when ready. Afterward, run a non-correcting parity check to verify data before trusting parity.
ImportArrayWizard.importedDisksDesc_other: Imported {{count}} disks. Review the array status, then start the array when ready. Afterward, run a non-correcting parity check to verify data before trusting parity.

RestoreFromLocalWizard.pickBackupDesc2: This only reads the archive until you confirm on a later step.
